استرحن (form X)
# اِسْتَرَحْنَ (istaraḥna) /is.ta.raħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرَاحَ (istarāḥa)
# اِسْتَرِحْنَ (istariḥna) /is.ta.riħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرَاحَ (istarāḥa)
